approval_gate: Nolan approves every exact post. Silence is not approval.
cadence: applied to every draft; the denomination is part of copy review
first_installment_sketch: A denominated-numbers style guide post built from the directive's own examples: '195/195' is allowed only with suite, commit, environment, what the tests establish, and what they do NOT establish named beside it; same treatment for 2550 journal events, 50/50, 29/29, 41/41. No real suite numbers are quoted until the suite record supplies them.
inputs: any number proposed for copy: test counts, event counts, ratios
the suite, commit, environment and meaning behind it
name: NUMBERS EARN THEIR WAY
outputs: the denominated-numbers rule in the style guide
numbers in copy that survive the rule
purpose: Make numbers earn their way into copy: every number needs a denominator with meaning, otherwise it is a vanity metric.
template: For each number: WHAT SUITE (or source) / WHAT COMMIT / WHAT ENVIRONMENT / WHAT THE TESTS ESTABLISH / WHAT THEY DO NOT ESTABLISH / THE DENOMINATOR WITH MEANING. A test count without these is cut from the draft. Rule: readers must be able to tell what the number does not claim. The directive's worked examples (195/195, 2550 journal events, 50/50, 29/29, 41/41) are the training set: none of them survives without the five answers.
